buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NOT APPLICABLE Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: BY AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE(S) OF CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER/SAF 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Condition (ATC) 1. Refer T & C [Terms & conditions of Open Tender Enquiry] 2. This tender enquiry is issued without any commitment at this stage.

3. This tender enquiry is governed with AWEIL PM-2022.(available at downloads section of website https://a weil.in) 4. IP Address: If two or more firms are found to have submitted their bids through same IP Address, all th e offers will be summarily rejected without any further correspondence with the firms. 5. Supply order: (a) Supply order will be issued on yearly basis, based on confirmed target and supplier & supplied store pe rformance. (b) Supply order issued through GEM will be act as agreement between firm(s) & SAF. (c) Supply order issued by the SAF through in-house will supersede in terms of quantity & delivery period, over supply order/agreement issued through GeM. 6. L.D. Clause: If, firm found to fail the delivery of components period wise as mentioned, the quantity of t hat period will be deleted/staggered LD period wise will be levied.LD will be applicable @ 0.5% per week ( or part thereof) to 10% maximum of the value of the delayed supplies. 7. Firm should read, understand, and accept the special conditions pertaining to GST Tax Indemnity cla use attached in this TE. 8. Firm has to be an "Indian Enterprises" & conformance for the same has to be submitted by participan t firms. 9. Firm has to sign & submit Non-disclosure agreement (NDA) with buyer which is attached in this TE. 10. Firm has to submit the confirmation that 'the rate quoted by the firm against instant bid/tender will be fixed for bid/tender quantity in entire period of supply order issued through GeM portal'. 11. Copy of drawing: Being Intellectual Property/TOT drawing documents are included in this TE, hence c opy of drawing(s) is not attached. Interested bidder(s) can obtain the drawing documents after signing of N on-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) Annexure-B with Buyer. 12. Minor Modification in Drawing: Minor modification(s) may be carried out in drawing, accordingly existing drawing may be updated. The updated drawing shall be issued at the time of placement of supply order and DDO section shall certify whether the modification in drawing is major or minor in nature. The fir m shall supply the store as per updated/latest drawing provided at the time of supply order. 13. Inspection criteria: a. Firm is to comply all condition of Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP) issued with Supply order and submit all test certificates, Inspection reports, dimension reports as per Drawing, Quality Acceptance Plan (QAP), Specification & ATP for all the materials and processes mentioned therein. Firm to provide test certificates from NABL labs wherever applicable. b. Firm to submit test pieces of raw material along with test reports for chemical, mechanical and other tes t as per specifications mentioned in drawing/QAP/ATP/specifications of components/assembly. Firm to prov ide test certificates from NABL labs wherever applicable. 14. Pre-qualification Criteria: a. Firm(s)/ vendor(s) should be capable to manufacture & supply tendered item(s) as specified in drawing, specification, accordingly vendors shall be required to get themselves registered for the tendered item(s) at SAF. Vendors/firm(s) shall be required to submit their registration request if not registered for tendered store. The capacity of the firm shall be assessed for the vendor who has submitted their registration reque st at SAF for tendered store through VRRF. b. Firm(s)/vendor(s) are to ensure that duly completed VRRF along with requisite assessment fee (as appli cable) should be submitted on or before date of opening of tender either through email or physically. Faili ng to furnish as stated above, offer(s) is/are liable to be rejected without any further correspondence. c. Interested bidder(s) can obtain the drawing documents after signing of Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) "Annexure-B" with Buyer before TOD. Firm(s)/vendor(s) who have not collected the drawings before TOD, t heir offer shall be liable to be ignored considering futile bidding. Vendors/firm(s) is required to send reques t for providing drawing along with signed 'Annexure-B' NDA (with mentioned valid email, mobile number a nd aadhar number of person signing the NDA for drawing sharing/Password) at least 03 days before tender

/bid opening (TOD) to process the request. Drawing request will not be entertained for the same, received after said period. If three days before TOD falls on Sunday/Factory Holiday then the next working day will be considered as last day for obtaining of drawing. d. Bidder has to provide the written declaration that material given in the drawing has been understood by the bidder and bidder can outsource the requisite raw material for uninterrupted supply to SAF. Bidder sho uld also give a written declaration that Drawings of component have been completely studied and underst ood by the bidder and bidder will ensure uninterrupted supply meeting all the drawing dimensions and spe cifications mentioned in the drawing. e. The firm should have never been black-listed from any Govt. Agency, self declaration by the firm to be p rovided along with bid. f. Firm(s)/Vendor(s) should have following essential/core facilities (available in-house only) required for ma nufacturing as well as inspection/testing technologies for the tendered item as follows- -----> CNC Sliding Head M/c OR CNC Turning M/c -----> Dimensional Inspection (Metrology) facility g. Firm(s)/vendor(s) who are already registered for the tendered item (i.e. PIN SAF DRG.NO.SK-203 DF-0 9, Item code: 7014300018) shall also need to submit fresh VRRF application along with requisite assessme nt fee (as applicable) since essential/core and desirable facilities required for manufacturing, inspection/te sting technologies for the tendered item is incorporated in this T.E. . 7.
